description: This Java source file defines the class AuthorizedSubjectsEnforcer, which implements the Enforcer interface. It manages authorization logic for subjects, determining permissions and exposing subject information based on authorization context.

classes.name: AuthorizedSubjectsEnforcer
classes.description: A final class implementing Enforcer to enforce authorization rules by managing subjects and their permissions within a given authorization context.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the provided authorization context has unrestricted permissions for the specified resource and permissions.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns the set of subject IDs that have the specified permissions for a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns the set of subjects that have the specified permissions for a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns the set of subject IDs with partial permissions for a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns the set of subjects that have partial permissions for a resource.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Determines if there are partial permissions for a resource in the given context.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JSON representation of the resource's fields based on permissions, returning full or empty JSON accordingly.
